QuestInfo.name: A True Cure
QuestInfo.0: Deliver the willpower of past heroes to #p1101002#.
QuestInfo.1: #p1101000# will use the willpower of past heroes to cure the people. Talk to #p1101000#.
QuestInfo.2: The victims of Arkarium's bio-alchemy experiment are cured! Thank goodness! All those zoned-out people staring into space were starting to creep you out.

0.0: I see you've brought the bottled willpower I require. Show me.

yes.0: The empress will use this to cure the people. Go see her now; she's been waiting.
